slides.heading: Underscorify Substring
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Strings
slides.narration: Let's solve Underscorify Substring, a hard strings problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Wrap every occurrence of `sub` in `str` with underscores, merging overlapping or adjacent occurrences into one wrapped block.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Wrap every occurrence of sub in str with underscores, merging overlapping or adjacent occurrences into one wrapped block.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Find all occurrences, merge overlapping or touching ones, then insert underscores.
slides.narration: Find all occurrences, merge overlapping or touching ones, then insert underscores.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Insert underscores per occurrence then merge → messy
Mark covered chars, then emit runs → O(n · m)
slides.narration: Inserting underscores per occurrence and fixing overlaps is messy. Marking covered characters and wrapping each run is clean.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, collect occurrence intervals. Second, merge overlaps and adjacency. Third, insert underscores at boundaries.

slides.heading: Worked example

lines: testthis is a testtest to see if testestest it works

slides.caption: Find every occurrence of 'test'
slides.narration: Find every occurrence of test, including overlapping ones like in testestest.

slides.heading: Worked example

lines: testthis is a testtest to see if testestest it works

slides.caption: Mark covered characters
slides.narration: Mark every covered character. Overlapping and adjacent occurrences merge automatically.

slides.heading: Worked example

lines: _test_this is a _testtest_ to see if _testestest_ it works

slides.caption: Underscore each marked run
slides.narration: Put an underscore before and after each marked run.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: We mark characters covered by each occurrence, then emit underscores at the start and end of each marked run.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n times m. Space is O of n.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Search from i plus one to catch overlaps, and adjacent occurrences merge.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
slides.narration: Mention collecting intervals and merging them.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Find all occurrences, merge overlapping or touching ones, then insert underscores.
slides.narration: To recap Underscorify Substring: Find all occurrences, merge overlapping or touching ones, then insert underscores. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
